newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Goh Ban Huat gets nod to buy assets.
newsitem.headline: Goh Ban Huat gets nod to buy assets.

text.p: Malaysian ceramic ware manufacturer Goh Ban Huat Bhd said it has received approval from the Securities Commission to buy seven property-owning companies at a revised price of 293.2 million ringgit.
The acquisitions from Arab-Malaysian Corp Bhd (Amcorp) would make Goh Ban Huat a subsidiairy of Amcorp, the company said in a statement distributed by the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Wednesday.
Goh Ban Huat said the acquisitions will be paid by issuing 48.9 million new Goh Ban Huat shares at 6.0 ringgit a share.
The company had earlier proposed to buy the seven firms for 298.0 milion ringgit.
The commission has also approved Goh Ban Huat's proposal to sell its existing businesses to Goh Nam Huat Realty Sdn Bhd for 110 million ringgit in cash.

Amcorp, as vendor of the seven firms, is required to provide a profit guarantee based on 100 percent of the maintainable profit for the assets for a period of three full years ending 1998, 1999 and 2000, the statement said.
The proposals are further subject to approvals from Goh Ban Huat and Amcorp shareholders.
Goh Ban Huat's stock which was requoted on Wednmesday, rose 60 cents to 6.85 ringgit.
Amcorp shares were unchanged at 8.85 ringgit.
